title: 23-BCV-009 — CSA B52:23 Mechanical refrigeration code

facts.text: The variance applies to equipment required to conform to CSA B52 under Sentences 6.2.1.5.(1) and 9.33.5.2.(1).
It permits conformance with CSA B52:23 to satisfy the NBC(AE) installation-standard requirements.
The source states that Division B Table 1.3.1.2. referenced CSA B52:18.
